row.title: ROI-SELF-1: /api/roi makes the pay-or-stay call itself (time vs cost, quality unchanged)
row.body: roi.js analyze returns time_vs_cost (throttled hours, projected paid bill per day against the soft target) and system_decision. Paid is worth it when the free plan throttled for 2 shed days or 12 h in the window and the projected bill fits inside half the soft daily target. The tick files one gate item ROI-PAY-<month> (kind gate, owner billing) with the default in effect (free plan, soft throttling); it closes once CF_PLAN=paid.
